what_this_is: the values other papers report on TCGA-BLCA disease-specific survival over the released five-fold case-ID splits. These are QUOTED, not measured by us. The file exists so that no figure script types a literature number into itself.
verification_note: `released folds` records what we could CHECK, not what we assume. Where a repository shipped its split files we compared them against the released ones; where it did not, the row says so.
gap_range_note: the paper quotes 0.002-0.012, which is the range over the SIX consecutive pairs among the entries that are within 0.03 of each other; the full range including the 0.596-0.625 and 0.646-0.667 steps runs to 0.029. Both are stated so the narrower one cannot be mistaken for the whole.

venue_distribution.note: counting the eleven method papers on this benchmark, of which nine carry a bladder value here. The single journal entry is DSCASurv, Briefings in Bioinformatics.
